name: abi_poke_masking
title: ABI: poke masks the value to the port width
description: MaskProbe is a pure 2-bit passthrough. Poking 255 and 4 (0b100) into In[2] must store 3 and 0: the scatter keeps only bits within the port width, observable both by peeking the input back and through the passthrough output.
